name: wikipedia
description: Search and read Wikipedia articles. Returns summaries or full article content.

action.description: Action: search titles, get summary, or get full article

manual.overview: Use wikipedia to quickly get encyclopedic knowledge. Search for topics, get concise summaries, or read full articles. Great for learning factual information about people, places, concepts, and events.

examples.description: Get a summary of a topic

tips: Use 'summary' for quick facts and 'full' for deep learning.
Use underscores instead of spaces in article titles.
Change language code for non-English wikis.
edge_cases: Disambiguation pages return multiple options instead of a single article.
Very niche topics may not have Wikipedia articles.
The API returns the main article — sections and references may be truncated.
